$comment: GENERATED from the repository by conformance/claims.py. Do not edit by hand — a hand-edited claims file is the drift it exists to prevent, wearing the costume of the fix.

gates.note: every gate the battery reports on the worked example

gates_unverified.note: the subset that cannot be decided from a file — and PASS-UNVERIFIED IS NOT A PASS

states_verified.note: the remaining two are open for NON-EQUIVALENT reasons and a surface that says '2 unverified' without them misreports

states_open.note: the complement of states_verified; open for non-equivalent reasons — known-incomplete (authorization) and design-choice (referral_lapsed) — and a surface that merges them misreports

not_derivable_here.$note: Claims a surface may carry that this file cannot check, listed so their absence is not read as coverage.
items: the F-PATCH-DELTA result — it lives in internal/, gitignored, and a clone does not receive it
every substrate row — measured in another domain, on another bench
anything about a real OPO, because nothing has run inside one
